text: Nothing changed overnight. The bazaar stands with every stall open and every seat full as the tea clock rings. I ask Gandalf: did you observe any movement at your stall’s neighbors before the shutters rose?

The bazaar’s first dawn shows every stall open and the graveyard silent—Gandalf, Ripley, Neo, Morpheus, Batman, and Inigo all confirm it. Elsa, your stall faces east: did you see any lanterns still low when the shutters rose? Hermione asked Inigo, Neo reported none, and Morpheus pressed the point—no proof the Doctor or Detective left marks. The roster is plain; let us move forward without echoing the silence we already share.
